summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.90/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.90 a gallon across Wisconsin as of November 7, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the lowest since September 9. AAA figures put the statewide average 30¢ lower than a week ago, 15¢ lower than a month ago, and $1.11 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Eau Claire ($3.69) and the highest in Rhinelander ($4.22).
